title: Accounts Administrator
company: Capital Outsourcing Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Administrator

Join a growing team and play a key role in keeping the finances running smoothly.

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Full-time Permanent Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

We're looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Accounts Administrator to join a busy finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in getting things right and thrives in a role where accuracy, organisation and teamwork really matter.

You'll play an important part in supporting the day-to-day finance function, working across accounts payable, customer accounts, payments, reconciliations and general financial administration.

What you'll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes
- Reviewing supplier statements and ensuring invoices are received and processed accurately
- Supporting the management and collection of outstanding customer balances
- Setting up new customer and supplier accounts
- Processing employee expenses
- Preparing and making supplier payments
- Handling incoming finance-related queries by phone and email
- Processing payments securely over the phone
- Posting bank transactions using accounting software
- Managing the finance team inbox and ensuring queries are dealt with promptly
- Supporting the release of orders where payment requirements have been met
- Providing general finance administration and support to the wider team
- Taking on additional duties and projects as required

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a Financial Administrator, Accounts Assistant or similar role
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working with financial information and deadlines
- Confident using accounting systems and Microsoft Office
- Enjoys working in a fast paced and busy environment
- Reliable, proactive and able to manage competing priorities
- A positive team player who is happy to get stuck in

Previous experience using SAP or similar business/accounting systems would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Why join us?

This is more than a processing role. You'll become an important part of a collaborative finance team and have the opportunity to develop your skills across a broad range of financial activities.

We offer:
- £30, 000 annual salary
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Company pension
- On-site parking
- A supportive team environment
- Opportunities to develop your finance experience

The role

Job title: Accounts Administrator

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

Working arrangement: Office-based

COG LTD are acting as an employment agency.

title: Accounts Assistant 20 hrs Part time
description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity in the Pocklington area? Do you enjoy working in a varied finance role where no two days are quite the same? Are you someone who takes pride in keeping things organised, spotting the detail that others miss and getting stuck in to help the wider team?

If so, this Accounts Assistant job in the Pocklington area could be exactly what you're looking for.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful and growing manufacturing business with a friendly, down-to-earth culture. Working closely with the Finance Manager, you'll become an important part of a small finance team, supporting the day-to-day running of the accounts function while helping the business through an exciting transition to a new finance system. This is a hands-on role where your initiative, organisation and willingness to muck in will be valued just as much as your finance experience.

What the Accounts Assistant job involves

As the Accounts Assistant, you'll provide support across a variety of finance activities, including:

Managing the sales ledger, raising invoices and ensuring customer accounts are accurate.

Chasing outstanding payments and carrying out credit control activities professionally over the telephone.

Processing purchase ledger invoices and reconciling supplier statements.

Investigating and resolving invoice and account queries.

Supporting purchasing administration and maintaining accurate records.

Assisting with goods received documentation and ensuring paperwork is completed correctly.

Maintaining accurate financial records using the company's accounting systems.

Supporting the finance team during the implementation of a new ERP system, including data migration and checking information for accuracy.

Producing reports and maintaining spreadsheets using Microsoft Excel.

Working closely with colleagues across different departments to resolve queries and ensure the smooth running of the finance function.

Supporting month-end activities and providing general accounts administration as required.

Skills required

We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of their work and isn't afraid to investigate problems or suggest improvements. You'll ideally have:

Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger or Sales Ledger role.

Experience of both sales ledger and purchase ledger processes.

Credit control experience with confidence speaking to customers over the telephone.

Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.

The ability to prioritise your workload and work independently using your own initiative.

Strong communication skills and a friendly, approachable manner.

Good Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience using Sage would be advantageous, whilst knowledge of SAP Business One would be highly desirable, although training will be provided.

A proactive, positive attitude and a willingness to support colleagues whenever needed.

Someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team and will fit naturally into a friendly office environment.

Other information

Part time, permanent position

20 hours per week

Tuesday to Thursday: 9:00am - 2:00pm

Friday: 8:30am - 1:30pm (early finish every week)

Auto-enrolment pension

Cash healthcare plan

Employee discounts on company products

Free on-site parking

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive, if you have not heard from us within two weeks, please assume you have not been shortlisted for this particular role.
